panchangamObservances.ekadashi_at_sunrise: Ekadashi Tithi is present at sunrise. This is an astronomical observation, not confirmation of the fasting date.
panchangamObservances.smarta_validation: Ekadashi is present at sunrise. Smarta fasting-date selection requires validation of the applicable traditional rules.
panchangamObservances.arunodaya_validation: Ekadashi is present at both Arunodaya and sunrise. This is a candidate for further tradition-specific fasting-date validation, not an official date.
panchangamObservances.dashami_vedha_validation: Dashami is present at the 96-minute pre-sunrise checkpoint. Madhwa/Vaishnava fasting-date selection requires detailed Dashami Vedha validation.
panchangamObservances.dawn_boundary_validation: The Arunodaya and sunrise Tithis differ. Additional traditional rules are required.
panchangamObservances.ekadashi_begins_validation: Ekadashi begins after sunrise and continues into the following sunrise. The next date must be evaluated for Smarta and Madhwa/Vaishnava fasting eligibility.
panchangamObservances.ekadashi_skipped_validation: Ekadashi occurs between consecutive sunrises but is absent at both. The fasting date requires special traditional rules.
panchangamObservances.repeated_ekadashi_validation: Ekadashi is present at consecutive sunrises. Tradition-specific fasting-date selection is required.
panchangamObservances.dwadashi_skipped_validation: Dwadashi occurs before the next sunrise but is absent at that sunrise. Parana must be reviewed using tradition-specific rules. Do not publish an automatic fast-breaking time.
panchangamObservances.pradosha_validation: Trayodashi overlaps the evening Pradosha screening window. Traditional observance-date selection requires validation.
panchangamObservances.purnima_validation: Purnima Tithi is present at sunrise. Festival-specific observance rules remain pending.
panchangamObservances.amavasya_validation: Amavasya Tithi is present at sunrise. Traditional observance rules remain pending.
panchangamObservances.skipped_tithi_validation: The Tithi occurs between consecutive sunrises but is absent at both. The religious observance date requires review.
panchangamObservances.ekadashi_assessment_note: Preliminary Ekadashi assessment only. Smarta and Madhwa/Vaishnava fasting rules, Dashami Vedha, repeated Tithi and Parana requirements must be independently validated before publication.
panchangamObservances.parana_warning: No official Parana date or time has been confirmed. Traditional rules and temple guidance must be verified.
panchangamObservances.calculation_note: Dynamic astronomical calculations use Swiss Ephemeris Moshier and Lahiri ayanamsa. The Ugadi, Amanta, exceptional-month and regional observance rules remain preliminary and require independent validation.

templeLocationLocal.title: Temple Location
templeLocationLocal.maps_description: Open the temple location and get directions from your current location.
templeLocationLocal.journey_description: Plan your journey to Divyakshetra Hariharapura
templeLocationLocal.air_description: The closest major airports are Bangalore, Mangalore and Shivamogga. Divyakshetra Hariharapura is reachable by road from all these airports.
templeLocationLocal.road_distance: Bangalore is about 280 Kms and Mangalore is about 125 Kms from Divyakshetra Hariharapura.
templeLocationLocal.bus_service: Buses, private or state, run day and night with regular frequency from both these cities.
templeLocationLocal.sleeper_bus: There are also night sleeper buses operating from Bangalore to Hariharapura.
templeLocationLocal.train_from_bangalore: Disembark at Shimoga if traveling from Bangalore. It is a 3-hour bus trip from there.
templeLocationLocal.train_from_mumbai: If traveling from Mumbai by Konkan Rail, disembark at Udupi or Mangalore. It is again about a 3-hour drive from these cities.
templeLocationLocal.pilgrim_description: The famous pilgrim centres of Sringeri and Shakatapura are located close to Divyakshetra Hariharapura.
